segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone oily skin describe the oil as moisturizing without extra grease and report fewer breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including very dry skin around the eyes, hands, feet and cuticles, report deep, lasting moisture and less flaking.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (blackheads/whiteheads, or combination-oily-sensitive) report smaller pores, fewer blackheads and a calmer, more balanced complexion.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, allergic or fragrance-reactive skin generally tolerate the oil well, citing no irritation or breakouts and valuing its fragrance-free formula, though one reviewer with rosacea saw no change in redness.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin uses it for winter dryness and calls it a game changer.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin report softer fine lines, a reduced crepe look and use it as an anti-aging step.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the oil against fine lines, wrinkles and crepey skin report visible softening, including one whose wrinkle line was reported gone and another whose neck crepe look was drastically reduced.
concerns.dehydration: This is the most consistently reported benefit: reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin (face, hands, feet, cuticles) describe deep, non-greasy moisture; one reviewer, however, says it dried out both her skin and hair.
concerns.redness: One reviewer's hot-shower-triggered red bumps healed within a week when combined with aloe vera, but a reviewer with rosacea reports no improvement, saying the oil just sat on top of her skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the oil with helping repair her skin barrier alongside moisturizing.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of dark marks, acne scars and uneven tone, with one describing a roughly 5% reduction in scarring visible day to day.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone, hormonal or PCOS-related acne say the oil does not clog pores or cause breakouts, and some report active acne or whiteheads clearing; one reviewer cautions that using too much can trigger breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin say the oil helps balance sebum and reduce blackheads/whiteheads without a greasy film, with one noting her face felt less oily after it absorbed.

extraits.titre: Made my hair brittle and skin dry
extraits.texte: I typically love this company and use them often for other oils. I had ready that jojoba oil was great for skin and hair and decided to give it a go. Now this is my experience from the product and I’m not stating that it may not help others, however it dried both my skin and hair out so badly and made a bunch of my hair fall out that I had to stop after a few uses. Typically I use tallow for my skin and no oil for my hair, but I’ve been reading how oiling can help with hair growth (mine is super long but I’m trying to grow it even longer) and decided to do a warm oil mask (I’ve done these before) and to use a few drops to help my hair be even shinier. After my oil mask my hair was dry and brittle and a ton of hair fell out. Like clumps. My hair continued to fall out for weeks after the treatment until I used a clarifying wash and then it stopped. This has NEVER happened before, so you can imagine my surprise. Just wanting to mention as a just incase. Note: The picture of my hair clump was happening 3-4 times+ a day. I’ve lost so much because of this product. :(

extraits.titre: PCOS/Acne-Prone Girlies: This is your holy grail!
extraits.texte: I have PCOS and acne-prone skin, so I’m extremely careful about what goes IN and ON my body. I tried so many “acne-safe” moisturizers over the years and nothing worked. My skin would either break out or feel tight and irritated. A few years ago I gave jojoba oil a try because I read it’s non-comedogenic. Honestly? Magic. This brand specifically has become my holy grail. It’s 100% pure, cold-pressed, organic, and fragrance-free. so I trust it with my sensitive skin. It never breaks me out, never clogs pores, and absorbs fast without that greasy film. Since switching to jojoba as my moisturizer, my skin is calmer, less angry, and has this healthy glow I never had before. It even feels like a natural anti-aging step. I’m on maybe my nth bottle now, which is why I finally decided to leave a review to help others. Recent game-changer: I started mixing it with a few drops of castor oil at night. Another best decision. The combo is so nourishing but still doesn’t break me out. If you’re a PCOS girlie or struggling with acne-prone skin like me.. trust me, give this a try. It won’t break you out. My skin has changed for the better since I made the switch. So grateful I found this.

extraits.titre: Life saver for my dry skin!
extraits.texte: I cannot say enough good things about this product. My skin is naturally very dry, especially around my eyes. This is the only skin product I have that actually moisturizes my dry skin to the level it needs. It is odorless, doesn't leave a greasy feel, and absorbs well into the skin. My nails also love it. The cherry on top is that the product is so affordable. 10/10 and will be a staple in my skin care for years to come

extraits.titre: So worth it! Great quality and price.
extraits.texte: If you're searching for the best quality and price jojoba, no need to look any further! I use this in my daily beauty routine, and I think it has significantly improved my skin. I have very sensitive, combination skin. It's more on the dry side than oily. I used to breakout quite a bit, but now I only do every once in a while. Other great uses for this are: -To help out your lips when they're SUPER chapped. Put a very small drop on your lips, and then vaseline or lanolin to lock it in. This is a life-saver, as no matter what, my lips would never feel hydrated. It's even better if you do this before you shower, I've found that the heat makes it soak in even more. Also great to do before bed. -Using it as an add-in for beauty products, such as body scrubs, lip scrubs, lip balm, and so on. I haven't used too much of it in beauty products because coconut oil or other substitutes would be much more affordable, since you'd be using larger quantities of it. I started to use this September last year. Over 8 months, I still have a bit left. I'm definitely going to order this again. Hope this was helpful! I think it won't disappoint. How I use mine: After washing my face or showering. I spray witch hazel to moisten my face a bit, which is great for acne and inflammation, and makes it easier to apply the jojoba. It's quite thick and you only should use a small amount for your face. Using too much will cause break outs for sure. I gently apply the jojoba and let it soak in for a minute o

I have processed blonde hair and need a deep moisturizing organic oil for my curls to keep my hair hydrated from all the bleach. This is perfect for a over processed, broken, damaged hair. I use this every time after the shower and it makes my hair so soft! I get a lot of compliments on the texture and how soft it is. This is a secret bottle of heaven!! You can visibly see the different it makes and im super happy with it. Ive been using it for a while and tested on my face and skin in the winter living in CT. Its deff super moisturizing but i feel like it didnt sink into my skin. I also have rosacea and need help with redness and sensitive skin.. i didnt notice a different when i tried it, it just sat on top of it. This product can deff be used anywhere and it all comes down to what you prefer. I wouldnt use this on your skin in the summer.. its very heavy! Overall beyond happy with this :)

extraits.titre: Cliganic Organic Jojoba Oil – honest review for sensitive, acne-prone skin
extraits.texte: I was a bit worried at first because several reviews mentioned issues with the packaging, but mine arrived in perfect condition, sealed, secure, and honestly, the bottle and box design are really nice and sturdy. I have combination to oily skin that's also sensitive, dehydrated, and prone to breakouts. I live in a humid climate and I'm currently using this oil as the first step in my morning routine. I apply 2–3 drops to my face, massage it in gently, and then wipe it off with a damp cellulose sponge before using my regular cleanser. No irritation, no breakouts—actually, quite the opposite. My skin feels calmer, softer, and more balanced. It's super lightweight, absorbs well, and doesn’t leave any greasy residue when removed properly.

As I've gotten older my skin has developed unpredictable sensitivity to products I've used my whole life! I LOVE this oil! It is absorbed immediately into my skin without a heavy residue and leaves it soft and supple. I used it on my neck area as well and I was amazed the the crepe look was drastically reduced immediately! No sensitive reaction or irritation as well! Great product!
